armGroups.label: treated

armGroups.label: treatment-navie
armGroups.description: Patients with locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC who have not received prior systemic therapy

interventions.name: Disitamab Vedotin + tislelizumab + bevacizumab
interventions.description:
Disitamab Vedotin, dosing regimen: 2.0 mg/kg, intravenous infusion, infusion should be about 30-90 minutes (usually about 60 minutes), every 21 days a cycle, the first day of administration, continuous use.

Tislelizumab, dosing regimen: 200 mg administered by intravenous infusion every 21 days in a cycle on the first day, continuous.

Bevacizumab, dosing regimen; 7.5 mg/kg administered by intravenous infusion every 21 days in a cycle on the first day of continuous use.

primaryOutcomes.description: It refers to the proportion of patients whose tumors shrink to a certain amount and remain for a certain period of time, including cases of complete response (CR) and partial response (PR).

secondaryOutcomes.description: Refers to the time from the date of initiation of combination therapy to any objectively documented tumor progression or patient death (the last follow-up time for patients lost to follow-up; Patients who are still alive at the end of the study will be the end of follow-up at the end of the study).
